title: [F1-S6 DRY RUN · SACRIFICIAL · do-not-merge] pipeline smoke — add lib/dryrun-smoke.ts + test
body:
**F1-S6 (#9) end-to-end supervised dry run — SACRIFICIAL. Do NOT merge the resulting PR.**

This issue exists only to exercise the factory implement→gates→publish pipeline end-to-end for the first time (F1-S6, factory.md §11). The publisher-opened PR is **evaluated and CLOSED, not merged**; both this issue and its PR are closed once the dry-run baseline/metrics are captured on #9. The change is deliberately trivial, self-contained, and non-load-bearing so the pipeline's success is not confounded by task difficulty.

**Plan link:** exempt — sacrificial F1-S6 dry-run / meta-issue (factory.md §5 dry-run exemption, D136). Refs #9.

## Spec

Add one tiny pure utility and its unit test.

**`lib/dryrun-smoke.ts`** — export:

```ts
export function dryRunSmoke(label: string): string {
  const trimmed = label.trim();
  return trimmed === "" ? "[dry-run] (empty)" : `[dry-run] ${trimmed}`;
}
```

**`tests/dryrun-smoke.test.ts`** — Vitest unit test (mirror `tests/slug.test.ts` style) covering **every branch**.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `lib/dryrun-smoke.ts` exports `dryRunSmoke` with exactly the behaviour above (pure, deterministic, no side effects, no `any`).
- [ ] `tests/dryrun-smoke.test.ts` asserts all three cases — a normal label → `"[dry-run] <label>"`; a whitespace-padded label → trimmed; an empty / whitespace-only label → `"[dry-run] (empty)"` — and the new lines are fully covered.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run test` all pass.
- [ ] TypeScript strict; follows repo conventions (compare `lib/slug.ts` + `tests/slug.test.ts`).

## In scope

- The single new source file `lib/dryrun-smoke.ts` and its single new test file `tests/dryrun-smoke.test.ts`.

## Out of scope

- Any change to existing files, exports, or call sites (nothing imports `dryRunSmoke`; it is a standalone dry-run artifact).
- Any protected path (`.github/**`, `.claude/**`, `.codex/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `snowflake/**`, `docs/state/registry.md`).
- Any dependency change (`package.json` / `package-lock.json` untouched), data/fixtures/generated output, binary, or migration.
- Wiring the utility into the app — it is intentionally unused.

## Verification

`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test` (Vitest) all green; changed lines covered.

## Size

~6 logic lines + ~15 test lines. Well under 400 logic lines and 2 MiB; single small PR.

## PR plan

One PR, one review unit: `lib/dryrun-smoke.ts` (~6 logic lines) + `tests/dryrun-smoke.test.ts` (~15 test lines, excluded from the logic estimate). No dependencies or ordering; single publisher commit. Factory-dispatchable envelope.

## Domain reviewer

**none.** The diff (`lib/dryrun-smoke.ts` + `tests/dryrun-smoke.test.ts`) triggers no Code Review Rubric routing condition: no `snowflake/migrations/**`, grants, secure views, or Zod/Pydantic validation (→ not `schema-migration-reviewer`); no routes/components/procs or reviewer-data/IP/visibility/deletion (→ not `privacy-auditor`); no factory-pipeline / `.github/**` / protected-config paths (→ not `factory-security-reviewer`); test churn ~15 lines, far under the 600-line `qa` trigger. A pure standalone utility + its unit test.

## Depends on

**none.**
